note: Deep investigation of keyboard/escape handling during agent dispatch: The entire chain is non-blocking. stdin → StdinBuffer (10ms timeout for sequence splitting) → TUI.handleInput() → focused component (always the CustomEditor during agent runs). Escape triggers onEscape handler which calls agent.abort() → AbortController.abort() → cooperative cancellation via signal propagation. Three escape-override patterns exist: default (abort agent), compaction (abort compaction), retry (abort retry). Extensions can intercept input at 4 levels: onTerminalInput (global), onExtensionShortcut (editor-level), onEscape replacement, and BorderedLoader pattern.
